name: M. Reno Hidayat Portfolio
description: Interactive portfolio website of M. Reno Hidayat, S.Kom. — Full Stack Engineer specializing in React, Three.js, Laravel, Flutter, and FastAPI. Features 3D interactive hero with WebGL, project showcases with live demos, certificate gallery, scientific publication, bilingual (Indonesian/English), and responsive design. Built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and deployed on Firebase Hosting.
